summary.headline: Solar Declination and Stellar Latitude
summary.text: Discussion of the Sun’s northern and southern declination as it moves between the equinoxes, solstitial points, and zeniths across inhabited regions, with mention of Capricorn and the zodiac. The text then introduces stellar latitude as distance from the celestial equator.
